description.value: Taste of Persia is a family-run, immigrant-owned Persian restaurant on Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, where owner and chef Javeed prepares everything from scratch using traditional techniques — charcoal-kissed kebabs, slow-cooked lamb shanks, and fragrant saffron rice. The restaurant holds a 4.9/5 Google rating from over 400 reviews and is 100% Halal certified. A weekend Persian breakfast service featuring housemade tanoori bread adds a distinctive cultural draw for cyclists passing through on Saturdays and Sundays.

Takeout is explicitly offered and 'Vegetarian Favourites' appears as a named menu section on the front page; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
